# signoz_plugin_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a SigNoz **v2** dashboard (`schemaVersion v6`, the Perses-spec API) built from WebComponent plugin panels (`signoz/WebComponentPanel`). Unlike `signoz_dashboard`, this resource talks to the `/api/v2/dashboards` endpoints and resolves panel plugins against the server plugin catalog (`GET /api/v1/plugins`) at apply time.

Catalog resolution, per panel:

- `plugin_version` omitted → the catalog's default manifest for `plugin_id` is used and the resolved version is recorded in state.
- `plugin_version` set → that exact version must exist in the catalog, else the plan fails listing available versions.
- `element` omitted → filled from the catalog manifest; set to something else → error.

Tag strings map onto the server's `{key, value}` pairs: a plain string becomes key `tag`, and `key:value` becomes that pair. A server tag with key `tag` and value `foo` therefore reads back as plain `foo` — avoid configuring the literal string `tag:foo`. Tag keys `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `locked`, and `source` are reserved by the server and rejected at plan time; at most 10 tags are allowed.

Grid rules (also validated at plan time): every panel needs `w >= 1`, `h >= 1`, `x >= 0`, `y >= 0`, and `x + w <= 12`; panels on a page must not overlap; at most 100 panels per page and 500 pages per dashboard.

Panel `id` is the server's panels-map key. It is generated when omitted and kept in state so plans stay stable. The `properties` JSON string is stored normalized (sorted keys, compact); whitespace differences in your config surface as cosmetic diffs only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a SigNoz v2 dashboard of WebComponent plugin panels.
# devops-status ships in the SigNoz plugin catalog (plugins/devops-status);
# check your server's catalog via GET /api/v1/plugins for available ids.
resource "signoz_plugin_dashboard" "devops_status" {
  title       = "DevOps Status"
  description = "Real-time infrastructure and application status dashboard"
  tags        = ["devops", "team:platform"]

  page {
    name = "Overview"

    plugin_panel {
      title     = "System Status"
      plugin_id = "devops-status"
      element   = "lax-devops-status"

      x = 0
      y = 0
      w = 6
      h = 4

      # HTML attributes on the custom element (the plugin reads env)
      attributes = {
        env = "prod"
      }
    }

    plugin_panel {
      title     = "Alerts"
      plugin_id = "devops-status"
      element   = "lax-devops-status"

      x = 6
      y = 0
      w = 6
      h = 4
    }
  }
}
```

A fuller board with a pinned plugin version and stub data passed via properties:

```terraform
# Lacrosse devops board: pinned plugin version, element auto-filled from the
# catalog manifest, stub data passed via properties.
resource "signoz_plugin_dashboard" "devops" {
  title       = "Fleet DevOps"
  description = "Terraform-managed devops WebComponent dashboard."
  tags        = ["lacrosse", "devops", "plugins"]

  page {
    name = "Fleet"

    plugin_panel {
      title          = "Fleet node grid"
      plugin_id      = "fleet-node-grid"
      plugin_version = "0.2.0"
      x              = 0
      y              = 0
      w              = 8
      h              = 6
      properties = jsonencode({
        mode = "stub"
        stub = {
          nodes = ["edge-01", "edge-02"]
        }
      })
    }

    plugin_panel {
      title     = "System status"
      plugin_id = "system-status-board"
      x         = 8
      y         = 0
      w         = 4
      h         = 6
      attributes = {
        "data-source" = "stub"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Import

Import by dashboard UUID (the `id` in state):

```shell
terraform import signoz_plugin_dashboard.hello 19da733c-f079-4c74-9a3a-24dfe4d8c1e2
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Dashboard title shown in SigNoz UI.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `page` (Block List) Dashboard page; maps to one Grid layout. At least one `page` block is required — the framework lists blocks as optional, but a plan with no page fails validation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--page))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags. A plain string maps to tag key `tag`; use `key:value` for any other key.

### Read-Only

- `document` (String) Canonical v2 dashboard JSON document (the POST body) for inspection.
- `id` (String) Dashboard UUID from SigNoz.
- `name` (String) Server-generated DNS name (immutable once created; regeneration requires replacement).

<a id="nestedblock--page"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page`

Required:

- `name` (String) Layout title (e.g. Overview, DevTime).

Optional:

- `plugin_panel` (Block List) WebComponent plugin panel on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--page--plugin_panel))

<a id="nestedblock--page--plugin_panel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page.plugin_panel`

Required:

- `plugin_id` (String) Registered plugin id in the server catalog (GET /api/v1/plugins).
- `title` (String)

Optional:

- `attributes` (Map of String) HTML attributes on the custom element.
- `config_keys` (List of String) Config keys this panel instance needs resolved.
- `element` (String) Custom element tag (must contain a hyphen). Filled from the plugin catalog manifest when omitted; a mismatch with the manifest is an error.
- `h` (Number)
- `id` (String) Panel id (the server panels-map key). Auto-generated when omitted and kept in state for stability.
- `plugin_version` (String) Plugin version to pin. When omitted, the server catalog's default version is used and recorded here.
- `properties` (String) JSON object of JS properties for the element. Stored normalized (sorted keys, compact); formatting differences in config show as cosmetic diffs.
- `w` (Number)
- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)
